description: Connect all frontend to real backend APIs, implement settings persistence, public profiles, Resend email templates, mobile polish, notification system, direct booking flow, and production hardening.
run_mode: AFK-safe for most tasks. HITL recommended for P4-03 (preferences schema), P4-06 (email), P4-20 (deploy).
prerequisites: Phase 1, 2, 3 complete. Dashboard UI built. Workers running. Rate limiting active.

items.title: PATCH /api/users/me — Update Profile
items.description: Allow users to update displayName, timezone, and username from Settings > Account tab.
steps: PATCH /api/users/me accepts { displayName?, username?, timezone? }
Validate: displayName min 2 chars, username min 3 chars alphanumeric+dash+underscore, timezone valid IANA string
Username uniqueness check — 409 if taken by another user
Settings > Account tab: Name row → pencil icon opens inline edit with Save/Cancel
Settings > Account tab: Timezone → select dropdown with common timezones
On save: toast 'Profile updated', invalidate ['currentUser'] React Query cache
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: Avatar Upload — POST /api/users/me/avatar
items.description: Allow users to upload a profile picture stored on the server.
steps: POST /api/users/me/avatar accepts multipart/form-data with field 'avatar'
Validate: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, max 5MB
Resize image to 200x200px using sharp package
Store in apps/api/public/avatars/{userId}.jpg, serve as /avatars/*
Update user.avatarUrl = '/avatars/{userId}.jpg'
Frontend: avatar in Settings > Account clickable to upload
After upload: invalidate ['currentUser'] cache
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: User Preferences Schema & API
items.description: Add UserPreferences model to store notification and matching preferences persistently.
steps: Add UserPreferences model to Prisma schema (new migration)
Fields: googleCalendarSync, emailCalendarInvites, performanceReports, desktopNotifications, quietMode, preferFavorites, timeFormat, weekStartsOn, autoRematch, mutedOnJoin, availability
GET /api/users/me/preferences — returns prefs (creates defaults on first call)
PATCH /api/users/me/preferences — updates any subset of fields
useUserPreferences() hook fetches and caches preferences
Settings > Notifications tab: each toggle calls PATCH /api/users/me/preferences
Settings > Preferences tab: each edit row reads from prefs
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: Public Profile Page — /profile/[username]
items.description: Public profile page with stats and 'Book a Session' CTA.
steps: GET /api/users/:username/profile — public fields only (never passwordHash, email, strikeCount)
Returns: id, displayName, username, avatarUrl, categories, createdAt, totalCompletedSessions, currentStreak
404 if user not found, banned, or inactive
Frontend: /profile/[username]/page.tsx — avatar, name, categories, stats, 'Book a Focus Session' button
'Book' button opens DirectBookingModal (P4-05)
Own profile: shows 'Edit Profile' button
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: Direct Partner Booking — POST /api/sessions/direct
items.description: Book a session directly with a specific partner from their profile.
steps: POST /api/sessions/direct: { partnerId, slotTime, durationMin }
Validations: future slotTime, 15-min boundary, durationMin in {25,50,75}
Block check both directions → 403
Free tier + email verification check
Overlap check for BOTH users
Creates Session with status=CONFIRMED, schedules jobs, sends emails + WebSocket
Frontend: DirectBookingModal on /profile/[username]
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: Resend Email Templates — All Transactional Emails
items.description: Implement all email templates with Resend SDK. Replace all console.log stubs.
steps: Install Resend SDK: bun add resend
Add RESEND_API_KEY to packages/env/src/server.ts
Templates: Welcome/Verification, Booking confirmation, Reminder 24h, Partner no-show, Strike warning, Ban notification, Booking expired, Password reset
All emails: responsive HTML, #0245A3 branding, unsubscribe footer
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: My Schedule Page — Upcoming + Past Sessions
items.description: Full schedule view with Upcoming/Past tabs and session management.
steps: Dashboard Schedule tab (calendar icon on mobile): shows My Schedule
Upcoming sub-tab: sessions grouped by date, Join button 5min before, Cancel (×), menu (...)
Past sub-tab: grouped by date, status badge, expandable reflection snippet
Connects to GET /api/sessions/upcoming and GET /api/sessions/history
WebSocket 'session:confirmed' refreshes upcoming list
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: Favorites Schedule Page
items.description: Show scheduled sessions with frequent partners, filtered by duration.
steps: Dashboard Favorites (star) tab: shows Favorites Schedule
Filter bar: All | 25m | 50m | 75m | Quiet [toggle] | Refresh
Shows sessions with top partners over next 5 days
Empty state if none
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: In-App Notification Center
items.description: Persistent notification center with unread count badge.
steps: Add Notification model to Prisma schema
Fields: id, userId, type (enum), title, body, isRead (default false), metadata JSON?, createdAt
Update NotificationService to also persist to DB
GET /api/notifications — paginated, newest first
GET /api/notifications/unread-count
PATCH /api/notifications/:id/read
PATCH /api/notifications/read-all
Frontend: bell icon in right panel header with unread count badge
Clicking opens Sheet with notification list
WebSocket 'notification:new' updates badge
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: Session Room Report Modal
items.description: Add Report button to session room controls.
steps: Session room: Report button (flag icon, red) in controls bar
Opens Dialog with reason dropdown + optional description textarea
POST /api/reports: { reportedId: partnerId, sessionId, reason, description }
Success: toast, modal closes, session continues
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: Onboarding Flow — First-Time User
items.description: Guided 5-step onboarding after email verification.
steps: After email verification → redirect to /onboarding
Step 1: Welcome. Step 2: Timezone (auto-detect). Step 3: Categories. Step 4: Session lengths. Step 5: Avatar (optional)
Progress bar showing steps 1-5
PATCH /api/users/me/onboarding on complete
On complete: redirect to /dashboard with confetti
Skip if already onboarded (categories.length > 0)
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: Change Password & Password Reset Flow
items.description: Change password from settings + forgot password email flow.
steps: POST /api/auth/change-password: { currentPassword, newPassword }
POST /api/auth/forgot-password: { email } → sends reset email
POST /api/auth/reset-password: { token, newPassword }
Frontend: Settings > Account change password modal
Forgot password link on /login
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: Session Reflection — End-to-End
items.description: Ensure reflection modal works and reflections show in history.
steps: After session completes: reflection modal appears automatically
Text area + 1-5 star rating + Skip/Save
POST /api/sessions/reflections creates record
Session history shows reflection snippet with stars
Reflection editable within 24h
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: Mobile App — Full Responsive Polish
items.description: Every screen works perfectly on mobile (375px+).
steps: Dashboard calendar: full-height scroll, no overflow bleed
Bottom nav: 4 tabs with active state, 44px touch targets
Session room mobile: all controls accessible
Auth pages: keyboard-aware, no content hidden
All modals/sheets: full-width with safe area insets (pb-safe)
No hover-only interactions
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: Google OAuth — Complete Integration
items.description: Google OAuth login/register flow end-to-end.
steps: New Google user: create account, generate username, skip email verification, go to onboarding
Existing Google user: log in, go to dashboard
Google button on /login and /register
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: Upcoming Sessions — Working Join + Cancel
items.description: BookingPanel upcoming section has live Join/Cancel buttons.
steps: Join button: appears 5min before session, navigates to /session/{id}
Cancel (×): calls DELETE /api/bookings/:id, removes from list
WebSocket 'session:confirmed' adds new session to list
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: Calendar Multi-Select Booking — Full Flow
items.description: Calendar hover/click/Book/Clear UX fully functional with real API calls.
steps: Hover → user avatar + duration preview block
Click → Book (blue top) + Clear (bottom) inline overlay
Click Book → slot added to Selected list in left panel, queued block shown in calendar
Book N sessions (bottom bar) → POST /api/bookings per slot, toast on success/fail
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: Settings — All Tabs Fully Wired to Backend
items.description: Every setting reads from and writes to the API.
steps: Notifications tab: all toggles PATCH /api/users/me/preferences
Preferences tab: Quiet Mode, Prefer Favorites, Dark Mode PATCH preferences
Account tab: Name/Timezone inline edit PATCH /api/users/me
Account tab: Change Password modal
Account tab: Delete Account with 'Type DELETE' confirmation
All settings: toast feedback on save/error
On load: useUserPreferences() + useCurrentUser() provide values
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: Delete Account — GDPR Anonymization
items.description: Soft-delete / anonymize user data on account deletion.
steps: DELETE /api/users/me — anonymizes: email, displayName, username, passwordHash=null, avatarUrl=null, isActive=false
Keep sessions/reflections (for partner history), cancel pending bookings
Send confirmation email
Frontend: Settings > Account 'Delete account' → confirmation dialog with 'Type DELETE'
After deletion: redirect to /login with toast
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: Production Deployment Readiness
items.description: Prepare for production deployment.
steps: Audit all .env.example files, document all required vars
Add Bull-Board queue monitor at /admin/queues (admin-only)
Replace console.log with structured logging (pino)
Dockerfile for API, docker-compose.prod.yml
GitHub Actions: typecheck + test on PR
Sentry integration for error monitoring (API + web)
Health check endpoint returns DB + Redis + queue status
